change.title: pr-7
change.description: scale-color $lightness must use $secondary for dark themes
change.author: Jeff Atwood

findings.title: Light-theme color changed: primary 70% became primary 30%
findings.body: The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`. The first argument of `dark-light-choose` is the light-theme result (`common/foundation/variables.scss:46-52`), so it should stay 70% and the dark branch should be `scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)`. The line instead has `$primary 30%` / `$secondary 70%`, which darkens the `.custom-message-length` text on the default light theme. Desktop's equivalent rule in `desktop/modal.scss:94` uses 70%/30%. Fix: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`.

findings.title: Light-theme color changed: primary 30% became primary 70% (much lighter)
findings.body: The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` for `.topic-meta-data h5 a`. The light branch is now `$primary 70%`, so the bold username link becomes much paler on light themes. The dark branch is 30%, which is the mirror of 70%, not of the original 30%. Fix: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`, as done for the same colour in `common/base/topic-post.scss:15` and `common/base/user.scss:119`.

findings.title: Light-theme color changed: primary 20% became primary 50%
findings.body: The original `h3` colour was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`. It is now 50%/50%, which lightens the h3 on light themes. The desktop equivalent, `desktop/topic-post.scss:321`, correctly uses `dark-light-choose(primary 20%, secondary 80%)`. Fix the same way here.

findings.title: Light-theme color changed: `.group-member-info .name` primary 30% became 50%
findings.body: The original colour was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. It is now `primary 50%` / `secondary 50%`, so the name looks lighter on light themes and no longer stands out from `.title` below it. Use `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Light-theme color changed: `.group-member-info .name` primary 30% became 50%
findings.body: This has the same fault as in `desktop/user.scss`. The original colour was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. It is now 50%/50%, so the name is lighter on light themes and matches `.title`. Use `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

summary: Most of the 32 stylesheet edits correctly wrap the original colour in `dark-light-choose`, keeping the light-theme value and adding the mirrored `$secondary` lightness. Five edits change the light-theme colour itself, which the PR description doesn't cover. They are `mobile/modal.scss:102`, `desktop/topic-post.scss:291`, `mobile/topic-post.scss:182`, `desktop/user.scss:522` and `mobile/user.scss:497`. In each, the first argument no longer matches the original value. `embed.css.scss` imports `variables`, so the function is available there. I only read the files; I didn't build or render anything.
